headline: Approved July 14, 2026 minutes via roll call; committee discussed library programs, Lyceum updates, fundraising, and publicity.
summary: The committee approved the minutes from July 14, 2026 by roll call. Members discussed library programming, Lyceum activities, spring appeal results, art auction plans, publicity efforts, the annual meeting date, hiring a grant writer, and promoting Saunders House.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the July 14, 2026 meeting as presented, by roll call vote.

decision_evidence.quote: The minutes were approved, as presented, via roll call.

plain_text:
Page 1 of 3 
 
Gloucester Lyceum & Sawyer Free Library 
Corporate Communications Committee  
Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 9:00 AM 
Conference Room, 2 Dale Avenue, Gloucester MA 
As the recent amendments to the open meeting law allows, this Committee will continue to hold meetings 
remotely. Adequate alternative access to the meeting is provided through the zoom link below. 
And via Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86018488672 
To join by phone:  646-931-3860  
 
Attendance: in person: Fran Aliberte (Chair), Christine Araujo, Christine Armstrong, Jason 
Brisbois, Cheryl Marks, Dawn Sarrouf, Library Director Jenny Benedict, Assistant Library Director 
Lisa Ryan (left at 10:00), and guests Geoff Bradford, and Julia Brotherton (joined at 9:15) 
 
Not Present: n/a 
 
 
1. Call to order  
 
2. Welcome + Introductions 
 
3. Approval of Minutes from July 14, 2026. The minutes were approved, as presented, via 
roll call. 
 
4. Library Programming Update - Lisa 
a. Summer Reading ends next week. Participation has been enthusiastic. 
b. There is a program at the Shalin Liu tomorrow done in collaboration with other 
Cape Ann libraries. 
c. Countdown to Kindergarten on August 20. 
d. Teen Room Art Unveiling on August 13. 
e. Lisa gave a preview of fall programming. Details are to be worked out. Highlights 
will include author talks, local history presentations, a creative art series, a 
Librarian recommendation series, a new technology series, some collaborative 
programs, and much more. 
 
5. Lyceum Update - Julia 
a. The gentleman who complained at the May Our Democracy event has continued 
to pur sue the issue. The Lyceum has brainstormed how best to respond. 
Discussion ensued within the meeting on appropriate responses.  
b. Upcoming: in November a panel presentation on AI. 
i. They have secured a headliner to moderate. More details to be worked 
out. 
c. Website: There was talk of creating a page on the SFL website for the Lyceum. 
Lisa will work on that.
Page 2 of 3 
 
6. Spring Appeal Final Numbers - Christine 
a. We more than doubled our goal of $60,000. 
 
7. Art Auction Update - Christine 
a. They are reaching out to artists. Selections will be juried. 
b. They are reaching out to potential sponsors. 
c. Some pieces will be in a silent auction and others in a live auction. 
 
8. Publicity Update - Fran 
a. We were in the Gloucester Daily Times twice last week. 
b. Fran reviewed local options for publicity. We are doing a good job listing events 
and programs. Staffing at GDT have changed and we need to work on re-creating 
a relationship.  
c. Brainstorming other ideas: sharing news and newsletters with other organizations 
to highlight collaborations; a community podcast (using the Library's new 
technology); recording programs to share on the website; having the Sound Artist 
in Residence promote Library technology services as part of their project; record 
tech-help sessions to share (Jenny commented that there are plans to record 
sessions and translate them into Spanish); offer some group programs (such as 
Mah Jong) upstairs -perhaps in the Matz Gallery - to encourage people to visit 
the rest of the Library; have Library staff welcome groups and speak briefly about 
other services/programs.  
i. Next year is the 100th anniversary of Fiesta. A Boston creator has already 
expressed an interest in using our services to record interviews with local 
people to share their memories. 
 
9. Annual Meeting 
a. Regularly scheduled for the second Wednesday of November. This year that falls 
on Veterans' Day. We may still hold the meeting on that day. 
b. Work on this will begin after the Art Auction. 
 
10. Grant Writer - Christine 
a. We are looking to hire a part-time grant writer. Both Jenny and Christine Araujo 
have potential leads they will share with Fran.  
 
11. Other: promoting Saunders House. Jenny will write up a blurb about work being done. 
 
12. Next meeting: Tuesday September 8, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. – 10:00 a.m. 
 
13. 10:25 Adjourn. There being no further business the meeting was adjourned. 
 
Respectfully submitted, Tracy Bowen 
 
 
Motions Summary 
n/a
Page 3 of 3 
 
 
 
Actions Summary 
Lisa will create a page on the SFL website for the Lyceum. 
 
Both Jenny and Christine Araujo have potential grant-writer leads they will share with Fran 
 
Jenny will write up a blurb about work being done on the Saunders House.
